annotation.title_clean: Singapore and the US to Deepen Cooperation In AI
annotation.title_en: Singapore and the US to Deepen Cooperation In AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (Singapore)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (mci.gov.sg)
annotation.summary_en: Singapore government press release on the inaugural US-Singapore Critical and Emerging Technologies Dialogue. It announces a crosswalk making IMDA's AI Verify interoperable with NIST's AI RMF, a planned bilateral AI Governance Group, deeper AI safety research collaboration, and a business roundtable on AI safety and innovation.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Verify and NIST AI RMF mapped through a joint crosswalk, the first such government-to-government exercise
Planned bilateral AI Governance Group to advance shared principles
Expanded research and technical collaboration on AI safety, testing, validation and certification
Business roundtable called for reduced fragmentation of AI standards, sandboxes and trusted data flows
Public-private partnerships stressed for AI trust and safety
